currentImplementationFlaws.mainIssue: Scores are not calculated by functions but are returned by AI based on prompts
currentImplementationFlaws.rootCause: The buildClarificationPrompt in smart-goal-processor.ts (lines 299-336) contains restrictive instructions
specificProblems: Line 312: 'Keep confidence LOW (0.3-0.5) unless the user provided comprehensive details' - This instruction prevents score increases
No separate calculateSpecificityScore(), calculateMeasurabilityScore(), or calculateTimeBoundScore() functions exist
Scores are entirely dependent on AI interpretation of the prompt, not on objective analysis of user input
The AI is explicitly told to be conservative with confidence updates

dataFlow.step1: ChatClarification.tsx calls goalAPI.clarifyGoal() with user responses (line 403)
dataFlow.step2: API sends clarifications to backend /goals/:id/clarify endpoint
dataFlow.step4: processClarifications builds a prompt with restrictive confidence rules
dataFlow.step5: AI returns conservative confidence scores based on the restrictive prompt
dataFlow.step6: Updated goal with low confidence scores is returned to frontend

exactLocationsNeedingFixes.currentCode: Keep confidence LOW (0.3-0.5) unless the user provided comprehensive details
exactLocationsNeedingFixes.issue: This instruction forces AI to keep scores low even when users provide good details
Hard-coded low confidence range in expected response
Overly restrictive rules preventing proper score updates

recommendedCodeChanges.change: Replace restrictive confidence rules with progressive scoring based on information completeness
recommendedCodeChanges.example: If user provides specific metrics, increase measurable confidence to 0.7-0.9

calculateMeasurabilityScore(userInput, currentValue) - Check for numbers, metrics, percentages

recommendedCodeChanges.change: After AI response, apply objective scoring functions to adjust confidence scores
recommendedCodeChanges.implementation: Merge AI suggestions with objective score calculations

stateManagementIssues: No local score recalculation after user input
Complete dependency on AI response for scoring
No validation of AI-returned scores against user input quality
asyncAwaitIssues: No async issues found - the problem is in the scoring logic, not the async flow

summaryOfFindings.primaryIssue: The SMART goal processor uses AI-generated confidence scores based on a prompt that explicitly instructs the AI to keep scores low (0.3-0.5), preventing proper score increases when users provide detailed information
summaryOfFindings.missingFunctions: There are no calculateSpecificityScore(), calculateMeasurabilityScore(), or calculateTimeBoundScore() functions - all scoring is delegated to the AI based on the restrictive prompt
summaryOfFindings.criticalFix: The buildClarificationPrompt method needs to be rewritten to allow progressive confidence scoring based on the quality and completeness of user input
